reviews.checked_passages: Section1 pp.1–3: closure, finite character, exchange, independence and bases, Lemmas1.4–1.6 and Proposition1.7. Section3 pp.8–9: strongly minimal/minimal terminology and Proposition3.8, inspected with its monster-model assumptions.
reviews.consumers: [Strong minimality and algebraic closure](entries/strongly-minimal-sets/entry.html): pregeometry terminology and finite basis exchange.
reviews.outcome: The corpus gives a separate elementary uniform finite/cofinite bound and algebraic-closure exchange proof using compactness; it does not import the monster-model proof or forking/rank facts. Only finite-dimensional basis-cardinality arguments are adopted from the compressed general dimension discussion. Modularity and later sections are not certified.
